content-manager.label: Page Title (SEO)
content-manager.description: Title shown in browser tabs and Google results. Keep under 60 characters.

content-manager.label: Meta Description
content-manager.description: Short description shown in Google results. Keep under 160 characters.

content-manager.label: Keywords
content-manager.description: Comma-separated SEO keywords (optional — not used by most search engines).

content-manager.label: Canonical URL
content-manager.description: Preferred URL if this content exists at multiple paths. Leave blank for default.

content-manager.label: Robots Directive
content-manager.description: Controls crawler access, e.g. "noindex, nofollow". Leave blank for normal indexing.

content-manager.label: Social Share Title
content-manager.description: Title when sharing on social media. Defaults to Page Title if empty.

content-manager.label: Social Share Description
content-manager.description: Description when sharing. Defaults to Meta Description if empty.

content-manager.label: Social Share Image
content-manager.description: Image shown when sharing on social media. Recommended: 1200 × 630 px.

content-manager.label: Twitter / X Card Type
content-manager.description: "Summary" = small image, "Summary Large Image" = big banner.

content-manager.label: Structured Data (JSON-LD)
content-manager.description: Advanced: paste a JSON-LD object for rich search result snippets.
